Name: Simple Billing - #Billing #Subscription Management for Telcos, Utilities and others
Description:
Simple Billing is a usage billing platform strongly geared and capable of billing for usage (anything that flows), for e.g. water, electricity, data, minutes, calls etc.

Simple Biling supports varied pricing settings that are configurable at various stages (product, customer, company levels) to provide flexbility to business on charging customer's in various ways.

It also supports Reseller Pricing via a feature called Company Hiearchies, where by you can have n level of companies, with differential pricing at each level, parent company can bill on behalf of the child company (reseller), control the prices of different resellers, collect the margin of difference via billing the reseller.

It comes with various Payments, Collections, Accounting & Tax Automations.

Simple Billing is available on SaaS model and is very suitable for Telcos, MVNOs, Managed Service Providers and Contact Centers.

Billing Automation with Simple Billing is a liberating experience for your operations team.

Billing Automation = Higher Cash Flow = Smaller Working Capital.
